proposals.evidence: CDIAL 12335 śarīra “body” gives Pali/Prakrit sarīra and Western Pahari sarīr. Conservative sibilants may reflect learned or intra-IA transmission; this provisional family link leaves that route open rather than claiming regular inherited sound change.
